label_free_first_reading: A short-haired woman in a pale blue clinical tunic stands beside a large illuminated circular apparatus. One palm presses lightly against its outer casing. A padded metal-sided table extends from the ring toward the foreground. Through the opening, a long empty corridor recedes into near-blackness. Her eyes turn toward the apparatus side, her brows pinch slightly, and her parted lips interrupt an otherwise still pose. The arrangement feels watchful and uneasy, with cold equipment occupying more of the image than the person. The table runs beside her rather than directly into her next step.
